invariants.rationale: The method returns records.collectAsList(), which guarantees a non-null List (assuming records itself is non-null).
If records is empty, collectAsList() will return an empty List, and vice versa.
The number of records collected into the List should match the number of elements in HoodieData.
Non-emptiness of the result List exactly matches non-zero HoodieData count.
Assuming HoodieData<HoodieRecord> contains no nulls, collectAsList() should yield a List with no nulls.
